name: Scrollytelling
description: Scroll-driven story: text steps scroll past a pinned visual panel that switches as each step enters the viewport.
whenToUse: Narrative content that unfolds in ordered steps — product tours, how-it-works walkthroughs, annual-report story beats, data stories. Reach for it when the user asks for scrollytelling, a scroll-driven story, a sticky/pinned walkthrough, or steps that highlight as you scroll. NOT for plain feature grids or short lists that fit one viewport — those don't need scroll choreography.
